definition: Answering a question that requires chaining evidence from several sources, and across 4 sources the setting where the archive's search-agent credit-assignment work is measured. Its diagnostic value is that it separates from single-hop cleanly: one ablation removing a forward solvability-gain reward costs 3.6 points of average with the damage concentrated in the multi-hop sets (57.7 to 51.8, 51.9 to 46.2, 28.6 to 24.2) while a single-hop set barely moves (45.5 to 44.6), which is how a source shows its reward term targets the intended failure. The corpus's standing cautions for this setting: a trajectory of many retrievals receives one terminal scalar, so nothing distinguishes the retrieval that found the key document from one that repeated a query, and macro averages over these suites hide per-benchmark losses -- including one method's undiscussed 17.9-point deficit on a single benchmark.

evidence.note: Gives each retrieval step of a search agent a dense reward built from two ground-truth-conditioned signals — how much the step raised the model's likelihood of the correct answer, and how necessary the step looks in hindsight — and fuses them asymmetrically so that a step which helps locally but is redundant globally is discounted.
evidence.title: BiCAA: Bidirectional Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Agent

evidence.note: Re-scores a search agent's own sampled tokens under a teacher that has been shown the instance's supporting evidence, and uses the detached teacher-student gap to nudge the GRPO advantage up or down on search and answer tokens only, without adding a distillation loss or changing anything at inference.
evidence.title: EviSD: Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents

evidence.note: Recasts long-document visual question answering as building an explicit evidence graph whose nodes are grounded document blocks and whose edges are reasoning dependencies, and verifies the graph causally — masking the evidence it cites flips 82.8% of correct answers while masking uncited evidence changes 9.6%.
evidence.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning

evidence.note: Builds an industrial-safety reasoning benchmark from two pipelines -- program execution over safety scene graphs, and evidence graphs extracted from real accident-investigation reports -- and shows that general multimodal capability does not transfer to it while a 9B model fine-tuned on its chain-of-thought split matches frontier systems.
evidence.title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge

name: multi-hop reasoning
